notes.coq9_functional_roles: YALI1E18269g: COQ7-family demethoxyubiquinone hydroxylase candidate; YALI1F34675g: COQ9-family lipid-binding/substrate-presentation auxiliary candidate. Native established symbols and biochemical localization unverified.
notes.coq9_functional_assumption: Conditional model hypothesis: native membrane-embedded long-chain substrate access requires the COQ9-family auxiliary protein for the represented COQ7 step. AND encodes functional dependence, not proof that both proteins catalyse hydroxylation.
notes.coq9_functional_counterevidence: Nicoll et al. 2024 Fig. 5b: ancestral COQ7 alone is active with nonprenylated substrate in detergent; COQ9 increases efficiency about 1.5-fold. A universal intrinsic catalytic AND is not supported.
notes.coq9_functional_limits: Cross-species inference; native Yarrowia COQ7-COQ9 obligatory pairing, localization and substrate access remain unverified. No growth essentiality claim; unchanged static Q9/Q9H2 pool has no net synthesis demand. COQ8 and COQ6 are not assigned by this hypothesis.
